summary: The PR improves request deduplication but introduces a cache lifecycle risk and misses one regression test around concurrent retries.

findings.title: Cached response can outlive business validity window
findings.explanation: Idempotency responses are returned without checking expiration metadata, which can replay stale state after settlement changes.
findings.suggestion: Store response with an explicit TTL and validate freshness before returning the cached payload.

findings.title: Missing race-condition coverage for parallel retries
findings.explanation: Current tests validate sequential idempotency only and do not assert behavior when two requests arrive at the same time.
findings.suggestion: Add a parallel execution test that verifies exactly one charge intent is created across concurrent requests.

generated_documentation.key_risks: Stale cache replay and untested concurrent retry behavior.
generated_documentation.design_technical_notes: Cache keying is clear, but lifecycle policy for cache entries should be explicit.
generated_documentation.test_recommendations: Add concurrency test and a stale-entry invalidation test.
